perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.desc: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.desc: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.desc:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.desc:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Built to Blast
perks.desc: Gain aim assist, stability, and flinch resistance while you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or Void Overshield.

perks.name: Rimestealer
perks.desc: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you Frost Armor.

perks.name: Lucky Shot
perks.desc: Reloading after a precision final blow causes precision hits to refill a round from reserves.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Triple Tap
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

perks.name: Ensemble
perks.desc: Improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

perks.name: Tunnel Vision
perks.desc: Reloading after defeating a target greatly increases target acquisition and aim down sight speed for a short duration.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Headstone
perks.desc: Precision final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal at the victim's location.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Explosive Payload
perks.desc: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.desc: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Collective Demolition
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Multikill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand.

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.desc:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

perks.name: Thresh
perks.desc: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Encore
perks.desc: Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Dream Work
perks.desc: Once per reload, assists or assisted final blows partially refill the weapon from reserves and increase reload speed for a short duration. Bows receive faster draw time.

perks.name: Nadir Focus
perks.desc: Sustained fire increases accuracy and range. Increases lunge distance for Swords, and projectile velocity for Launchers.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "I recently broke out my Something New from last season with Headstone / Wellspring which is a shame we cannot get that roll this year. The closest is a heavier investment into grenades with Demolitionist. While not the worst weapon, losing Wellspring puts this behind Eyasluna for me, yes even without the origin trait." Recommended MW - Handling.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "Potentially a higher stat version of Crimil’s Dagger, the Something New with Elemental Capacitor and Precision Instrument looks to take over your kinetic slot. I was waiting for this weapon to come up instead of trying within Iron Banner. Enhanced Void Elemental Capacitor giving you a whopping +25 in stability or +55 handling on Arc brings up the stats so much that you might forget about Igneous Hammer." Recommended MW - Range.

Enhanced Void Elemental Capacitor giving you a whopping +25 in stability or +55 handling on Arc brings up the stats so much that you might forget about Igneous Hammer." Recommended MW - Range.

SirStallion_ (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "For me, this combination is tried and true. Headstone will spawn stasis crystals that can serve as extensions of the gun.. Meaning those stasis crystal explosions will fuel demo. Handy dandy indeed, and allows for much spam. However, it's missing some reload, and like most 120rpm HCs, this big boi NEEDS it. With the Dream Work origin trait, you can certainly get by, but I still like to hedge my bets and get as much reload as I can from mag and MW. Plus, I'm sort of curious about Nadir Focus, so I wont always have Dream Work locked and loaded." Recommended MW - Reload.

SirStallion_ (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Now, I've given this thing a lot of stability. And it's going to get even more from Rapid Hit. To me, for PvP, my ability to hit shots with such a slow firing weapon is far more important than hitting for full damage a few metres further. Rapid Hit should hypothetically fix my reload problems as well as giving me more stability to help combat flinch. Kill Clip is just.. Nice. With how easy a lot of us can get Radiant going when we need to, the combo of damage perks should give me some slay potential. Otherwise, I'd definitely be looking at Explosive Payload just to annoy people." Recommended MW - Stability.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 72 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/5vRI9hBynq3jq712XCu7oc?si=c87cbb8036254e4a) with @ImpetusAlways, @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects. (??? ???): First-choice PvE pick for minor add-clear in end-game activities. Aggressive hand cannons have two main weaknesses - handling and reload speed. Fortunately, there are season 21 perk combinations that can help with that! Start with adding handling or a little extra stability with your barrel perk. You can go one of two ways with the magazine - either look for a perk that helps with reload or enjoy a combat effect perk and let the traits do the heavy lifting. While there are additional reload perks in the first trait column, you shouldn't really need them, so Wellspring offers useful ability energy on kills as your support trait. Then, in the second trait column as your signature perk, Frenzy maxes out handling and reload speed when procced, as well as providing a solid 15% weapon damage boost. The Dream Works origin trait is useful in a fireteam to get the occasional overflowed magazine in a firefight. Recommended MW: Reload Speed or Handling, with a damage-boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 72 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/5vRI9hBynq3jq712XCu7oc?si=c87cbb8036254e4a) with @ImpetusAlways, @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects. (??? ???): First-choice PvE pick for minor add-clear in end-game activities with a Stasis (probably Hunter) subclass. Aggressive hand cannons have two main weaknesses - handling and reload speed. So. start with adding handling or a little extra stability with your barrel perk, and look for a perk that helps with reload in your magazine. In the second trait column, as your signature perk, the second tier of Golden Tricorn can be difficult to proc with Stasis - shattering a target that's frozen with a Glacier Grenade will do it or, if you're a Hunter, your Shurikens will also work. To support that, you could go one of two ways with your first column trait - Rapid Hit, to speed up the reload speed and take full advantage of the 50% damage boost, or Pugilist to get melee energy back so you can proc it again sooner. The Dream Works origin trait is useful in a fireteam to get the occasional overflowed magazine in a firefight. Recommended MW: Reload Speed or Handling, with a damage-boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 72 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/5vRI9hBynq3jq712XCu7oc?si=c87cbb8036254e4a) with @ImpetusAlways, @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects. (??? ???): First-choice PvE pick for minor add-clear in general. Aggressive hand cannons have two main weaknesses - handling and reload speed. So. start with adding handling or a little extra stability with your barrel perk, and look for a perk that helps with reload in your magazine. In the trait columns, if you enjoy ability spam (and who doesn't?), you can unusually roll both Wellspring or Pugilist and Demolitionist to keep the grenades/charged melees/class abilities coming in a firefight. The Dream Works origin trait is useful in a fireteam to get the occasional overflowed magazine in a firefight too. Recommended MW: Reload Speed of Handling, with a damage-boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

WarlockMaggie (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "This Stasis weapon brings us solid perks like Headstone or Demolitionist. Stats for All plus Headstone is ridiculously fun. A quick warning. the intrinsic trait will make reload-based perks (like MKC and Tunnel Vision) near useless in team activities. For magazine options, choose getting more shots or increasing Stability/Reload, either or both will help combat common Aggressive frame issues. Barrels are similar: focusing on Stability and Handling over Range will make this gun feel much better in combat." Recommended MW: Reload or Stability

WarlockMaggie (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "This Stasis weapon brings us solid perks like Headstone or Demolitionist. For PvP, Harmony is unique to this 120 HC and allows for potential 2-tap kills. A quick warning. the intrinsic trait will make reload-based perks (like MKC and Tunnel Vision) near useless in team activities. For magazine options choose getting more shots, increasing Stability, or Dueling potential. Barrels are similar, focusing on Stability (or Handling) over Range. Overall, not the best 120 in the Crucible, but you can make it work." Recommended MW: Stability

Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 24. PvE first choice roll for end-game content. Use the barrel and mag to help out with the poor Handling, and Reload Speed. For end-game use, Ensemble helps both handling and reload when running in a fireteam, and Headstone works well with Stasis subclasses. Recommended MW: Reload Speed or Handling, with a Backup Mag mod.
